<STRUCT_0001>
Before we state the next lemma we point out that the <MATH_0001>-category
of categories fibred in groupoids is a <MATH_0002>-category, and hence
we know what it means to say that it has a final object (see
Definition <REF_0001>). And it has
a final object namely <MATH_0003>.
Thus we define <TEXTITOPEN_0001><MATH_0004>-products<TEXTITCLOSE_0001> of categories fibred in groupoids
over <MATH_0005> as the <MATH_0006>-fibre products
<MATH_0007>
With this definition in place the following lemma makes sense.
